ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity distribution with a high-intensity pixel ratio of approximately 0.02 to 1.0, where black/dark-gray pixels comprise over 98% of the surface area and high-intensity white pixels are limited to localized scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-field pigmentation across 98% of the visible surface; a single high-contrast white geometric ring-shaped feature is mapped to the mid-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration profile with jagged peaks and deep valleys (range 5-15 pixels) distributed continuously from the notch to the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex elliptical trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent high-contrast white ring-shaped cluster (approximate diameter 12 pixels) on the left lobe; additional micro-clusters of white punctate marks along the bottom center-line near the water contact zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle linear gray-on-black pixel disruptions visible as vertical rake marks concentrated near the central notch and extending into the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular ring-shaped scar on the left lobe; irregular white pigmentation clusters along the proximal edge where the fluke meets the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Type 5 pigmentation pattern (all-black) with exceptionally high-frequency serration density along the trailing edge boundary.
